stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2024 entering class; the 2025-26 CDS posted on the school's site has no readable values). 75% of all applicants were admitted, but only 242 of 1,110 international applicants (22%) were admitted and 33 enrolled, so international admission is far more selective than the overall rate. Early action available (non-binding); no early decision. C11 prints one GPA column (all enrolled students) with 'N/A' for the 3.00-3.24 band, so that band is omitted. Test-score submitters: 51% SAT (329 students), 6% ACT (39); the C9 heading says 'Fall 2023' but College Navigator shows the same percentiles for fall 2024.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8 (fall 2026) dropdown selections did not extract cleanly; the admissions site and catalog state that SAT/ACT are optional for most programs.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (2025-26 first-year): tuition $33,606, required fees $0, food and housing $10,636 (commuter food and housing $11,280 is also printed); G5 books and supplies $1,468. Tuition varies by program (G4: 15% of full-time undergraduates pay more). CDS H6 (2024-25 estimated): 126 degree-seeking undergraduate nonresidents received institutional aid, average $18,443 (total $2,323,779).
